primaryClipPolicy: Prefer provisionally event-audited observation; otherwise greatest sum of supported 2D frames. One whole observation interval per pitch. All alternate clips retained; no averaging across replays.

obp.title: OpenBiomechanics pitching README, POI dictionary and Visual3D pipeline
obp.notes: Force contact 10% BW and plant 100% BW differ from image contact. Lab +X plate, +Y first base, +Z up. Visual3D segment definitions are not SMPL joint-center definitions.

report.title: How to interpret biomechanics reports
report.notes: Field priorities: positions, velocities, sequencing and kinetics. Internal reference distributions are not KBO thresholds.

block.title: A quantitative analysis of the lead-leg block
block.notes: Knee extension, additional flexion and ground-force components are distinct; knee motion does not measure braking force.

knee.title: Lead-knee extension and pitching velocity
knee.notes: 480 Hz, 13.4 Hz fourth-order zero-lag filter; image/marker first toe/heel contact, BR 0.01 s after wrist passes elbow in +X. Our release is an image bracket, not that model event.

sequence.title: Professional-pitcher segment sequencing
sequence.notes: 287 professional pitchers; peak order and intervals are kinematic observations, not a measured energy-transfer score. Full operational methods not accessible; do not claim exact reproduction.

pelvis.title: Pelvic rotation in professional pitchers
pelvis.notes: ASIS marker line, closed 90/open 0 convention and PKH rear-ankle to FC lead-ankle stride differ from the chosen rest-calibrated SMPL frame and same-frame ankle stride.

game.title: In-game hip–shoulder separation
game.notes: 335 NCAA pitchers; weak time-local association and individual variation. Full methods inaccessible; motivates waveform/interval analysis, not a normative range or causal conclusion.

review.title: Systematic review of kinematics associated with pitching velocity
review.notes: Heterogeneous definitions across 12 studies / 930 participants. Associations do not establish cause or universal optimal mechanics.

accuracy.title: Metric-specific markerless pitching accuracy
accuracy.notes: 18 pitchers, multi-camera Theia/Hawk-Eye comparison to markers. Variable-specific agreement does not validate this monocular broadcast pipeline.

provenance.physicalClockPolicy: No physical deg/s or ms without a verified playback-to-real-time mapping. Image cadence diagnostics are not that mapping.
